notes: Two isnads for the same saying: «وعن قيس بن مسلم» (no «ح») is a second route from the same head (Al-A'mash), as the Abu Dawud correspondence shows with «ح».
«قال أخرج مروان المنبر» and the asker in the scene are not links; Marwan is in the story.
The archive flagged the same name twice in the chain; here «أبو سعيد الخدري» is the Companion of both routes and is numbered 1 and 2 in the text.
